purpose: judge whether an idea can be built and run within technical, time, cost and legal limits, before it is committed
entry_criteria: A candidate solution or options exist
Constraints on time, budget and compliance are known
An architect is available to assess
procedure: List the requirements that most affect feasibility, such as scale, integration, data and compliance.
For each option, assess technical fit, integration effort, skill gaps, operating cost and legal constraints.
Identify the largest unknown for each option and run a small spike to test it.
Compare options with the same criteria and show the scoring and the evidence.
Recommend an option, or recommend not to proceed, with the main risks and how to reduce them.
Record the assumptions that, if wrong, would change the recommendation.
acceptance_criteria: Options are scored on the same criteria

validation.check: confirm each option row has evidence or marked assumption
check the spike output is attached to the assessment

worked_example: ILLUSTRATIVE: Two options for ingesting partner data are compared. A one-day spike shows the partner's API limits rule out near-real-time polling, so the batch option is recommended with a note that the assumption about volume must be rechecked.
